audit_metadata.method: Independent verification against actual GitHub DCML repo overview tables (raw.githubusercontent.com). No trust in P20.3.7/P20.3.8 markdown claims or prior agent output.
rules: 1. No trust in existing markdown descriptions
2. No trust in prior agent output
3. Each case must find actual repo file evidence

status_legend.VERIFIED: Score file + harmony annotation + Roman numeral all confirmed in actual DCML repo overview table; design doc claim matches repo reality
status_legend.PARTIAL: File/harmony/Roman partially verified, but design doc claim has factual mismatch (wrong title, wrong opus mapping, zero labels, or content discrepancy)
status_legend.NOT_FOUND: Claimed file does not exist in claimed DCML repo

audit_metadata.license_common: All DCMLab repos are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (confirmed via web_fetch of each README's License section)

cases.title: Design doc claims 'Träumerei, D major, simple' — FACTUAL MISMATCH
cases.verification_evidence: README: 'n01 = Kinderszenen piece 1 of op. 15'. README references '13 pieces contained in op. 15' (Kinderszenen). File n01 exists with 22 measures, 44 labels (annotator: Tal Soker/John Heilig). But design doc claims this is 'Träumerei, D major, simple' — actually Kinderszenen piece 1 is 'Von fremden Ländern und Menschen' (G major), NOT Träumerei. Träumerei is piece 7. Design doc title/key claim is factually wrong for n01.
cases.partial_reason: File + annotation exist (22m/44l verified). But design doc's title 'Träumerei, D major' does NOT match the actual n01 piece ('Von fremden Ländern und Menschen', G major). The case_id maps to a real annotated file but with wrong design metadata.

cases.title: Design doc claims 'Traum eines Kindes, bVI test' — FACTUAL MISMATCH
cases.verification_evidence: README overview: 'n07 | 24 | 71 | 2.3.0 | Tal Soker (2.1.1), John Heilig (2.3.0) | AN, JHei'. 24 measures, 71 labels exist. But design doc claims this is 'Traum eines Kindes' — actually n07 IS 'Träumerei' (F major), the famous one. 'Traum eines Kindes' is not a Kinderszenen track. Design title is factually wrong for n07 (though happens to be a famous case suitable for benchmark).
cases.partial_reason: File + annotation exist (24m/71l verified). Design doc title 'Traum eines Kindes' does NOT match actual n07 (= Träumerei). 'Traum eines Kindes' is not in Kinderszenen Op.15.

cases.title: Design doc claims 'Sposalizio, 借用和弦' — INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY
cases.score_file: MS3/160.01_Chapelle_de_Guillaume_Tell.mscx (likely, but README overview table truncated in fetch)
cases.verification_evidence: README: 'First piece: 160.01_Chapelle_de_Guillaume_Tell'. Année 1 (Suisse) = 9 pieces, beginning with Chapelle de Guillaume Tell. Sposalizio is Année 2 (Italie) piece 1, NOT Année 1 piece 1. Design doc's case_id 's1_1' = Année 1 piece 1 = Chapelle de Guillaume Tell, but design title claims 'Sposalizio' which is Année 2. Case_id and title do not match. README overview table was not visible in fetched content (truncated before table).
cases.partial_reason: Repo exists with first piece file (160.01_Chapelle_de_Guillaume_Tell per README example) confirmed, license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 confirmed. But design doc case_id ('s1_1' = Année 1 piece 1) does not match design title ('Sposalizio' = Année 2 piece 1). Either case_id or title is wrong. Cannot verify the actual target piece (Sposalizio) without full overview table.

cases.title: Lohengrin Prelude (design claims 'A major, 半音')
cases.verification_evidence: wagner_overtures README overview (confirmed via earlier web_fetch) lists ONLY 2 pieces: 'WWV090_Tristan_01_Vorspiel-Prelude (111m, 359 labels)' and 'WWV096-Meistersinger_01_Vorspiel-Prelude (222m, 1074 labels)'. There is NO Lohengrin entry. Tristan Prelude is in D minor/chromatic, NOT A major. Design doc factually wrong: DCML wagner_overtures contains only Tristan + Meistersinger Vorspiele, no Lohengrin, no Tannhäuser. Annotation in repo: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 confirmed.
cases.not_found_reason: Lohengrin Prelude is not in DCMLab/wagner_overtures. DCML only annotated Tristan and Meistersinger preludes. Design doc's case 'wagner_lohengrin_prelude' has no corresponding file in the source repo. Additional fact error: design doc claims 'A major', but Tristan Prelude is in D minor (chromatic) and Meistersinger Prelude is in C major — neither is in A major.

design_doc_factual_errors_found: Case 14 (schumann_kinderszenen_1): Design claims 'Träumerei, D major' but n01 = 'Von fremden Ländern und Menschen' (G major). Träumerei is piece 7.
Case 15 (schumann_kinderszenen_7): Design claims 'Traum eines Kindes, bVI' but n07 = 'Träumerei' (F major). 'Traum eines Kindes' is not in Kinderszenen Op.15.
Case 16 (liszt_pelerinage_s1_1): Design claims 'Sposalizio' but case_id 's1_1' = Année 1 piece 1 = Chapelle de Guillaume Tell. Sposalizio is Année 2 piece 1. Internal inconsistency.
Case 21 (wagner_lohengrin_prelude): Lohengrin does not exist in DCMLab/wagner_overtures (only Tristan + Meistersinger). Design additionally claims 'A major' but actual pieces are D minor and C major.
Cases 11, 12 (beethoven_op27_2_1, beethoven_op106_1): Scores exist (69m, 405m) but NO harmony annotation in DCML repo (labels=0, no annotators). Cannot be Tier A as-is.
